note: DESTINATIONS-ONLY OVERLAY. paths[] is machine-neutral and is inherited from backup-manifest.json — it is deliberately not duplicated here, because a second copy would drift from the human-reviewed classification within weeks. Only destinations differ per machine, the same split already used by machine.md. Written 2026-09-11 after RECOVERY-INVENTORY.md found that the Windows laptop was reading the Mac's destinations, where only 'github' resolves. NOTHING READS THIS FILE YET: it is documentation until a Windows freshness checker exists (RECOVERY-INVENTORY.md fix #5). The two robocopy scripts hardcode their own paths and do not consult a manifest.

drive.note: Google DriveFS. G: is a PER-USER mount that exists only inside Eric's logged-in session, so any scheduled task writing here must run interactively as him. A task running as SYSTEM sees no G: and fails silently.

aiSessions.note: Codex sessions + memories, Claude Code projects. Not covered by GitHub at all.

github.note: Tracked files only. Never assume it covers gitignored data. This is the ONLY destination that resolved on Windows before 2026-09-11.

ssd.note: CRASHBOX is a Mac-attached exFAT SSD. No Windows equivalent exists. Windows has no local second copy of gitignored data — Google Drive is the only one.

knownGaps: KeystoneOS-DailyBackup and the other 8 Windows scheduled tasks are Disabled and MUST STAY DISABLED: ~/.claude/scripts/daily-backup.ps1 was replaced by the macOS port on 2026-08-05 (rsync, $HOME/DEV) and would fail on Windows. The Windows original is frozen at daily-backup.ps1.win-orig and reads the Mac destinations above. Reviving it needs this overlay to be wired in first.
No Windows freshness check. stack-check.ps1 is Mac-only (launchd). backup-state.json last written on Windows 2026-08-14 with status ERROR and nobody saw it for a month.
